The '''Rebel hangar''' was an old hideout of the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel Alliance]] on the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim]] planet [[Dathomir/Legends|Dathomir]]. It had been built years before [[1 ABY/Legends|1 ABY]]. The [[Wookiee/Legends|Wookiee]] [[Imarrra]] had once been on Dathomir and knew about this location.

1.5 ABY, the Wookiees Imarrra and [[Orrekazzapirr]] were captured on [[Kashyyyk/Legends|Kashyyyk]] and brought to the [[Dathomir Imperial Prison|Imperial prison]] on Dathomir. A [[Spacer/Legends|spacer]] sent by [[Kylantha|Queen Kylantha]] of [[Naboo/Legends|Naboo]] managed to infiltrate the facility and helped them escape. Imarrra remembered the hangar and together with Orrekazzapirr found her way through the Dathomirian wilderness to the hangar. There they found an old [[Aggressive ReConnaissance-170 starfighter/Legends|ARC-170 starfighter]] they used to break through the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] blockade and escape from the planet.

{{Struct-stub}}

==Behind the scenes==
The Rebel hangar appeared in the video game ''Star Wars Galaxies'', a massively multiplayer online roleplaying game developed by Sony Online Entertainment and published by LucasArts, prior to its closure on [[December 15]], 2011.
